_about: Proposed bus-stops entries for 7800 (plan docs/plans/7800-unified-arrivals.md §6), not pushed. Append to data.stops of a pulled bus-stops working file. Coordinates are TOPIS getStaionByRoute gpsY/gpsX for route 200000150 (__tests__/nest/bus/fixtures/topis-route-stations-7800.json, captured 2026-10-24), rounded to 7 decimals; confirm each pole on site before pushing. No subwayStationId on the two 사당 stops: the subway module serves no 사당 station (src/subway/subway.constants.ts). The 성균관대학교 poles carry no ARS number, so they alias their TOPIS station ids (topisIds); the 사당 poles alias their ARS numbers. Needs a server with the topisIds field deployed first (an older one refuses the key).
